text.content:
Latin name: Via Caeli

Virtues: Conscience, Self-Control

God has a plan for everyone, including the Damned. Followers of the Via Caeli (the Faithful) accept the burden the Lord has laid upon them, knowing that working for a divine cause is enough to save their souls, even as their existence is a constant test of faith. The Beast is the voice of Satan and is to be spurned, along with sin, temptations, infernalism, demons, and followers of the Road of Sin. The Faithful are found wherever Christianity springs, though some follow Islam or Judaism, especially in Outremer, and a rare few claim to have met pagans on the road, usually in the northern lands or Britain.

The Ethics:

  • God laid His mark upon Caine and his childer as part of His great plan.
  • The word of God is law. Defiance of God is sin that leads to damnation.
  • No one is above God's law.
  • Love and serve God in all things.
  • Deny the Devil through denial of the Beast and all creatures of Hell.

Aura of Conviction (Holiness): Holiness. The devout nature of followers of the Via Caeli inspires those around them, creating an aura modifier that applies to their appearance as divine beings.

Hierarchy of Sins (most to least severe):

  1. Violating any of the Ten Commandments, for any reason; failing to speak out against corruption and sin.
  2. Acting out of pride, avarice, gluttony, or some other sinful impulse; theft, robbery, willful vandalism.
  3. Causing harm to a pious and virtuous person; feeding from an innocent without permission.
  4. Blasphemous or heretical acts; allowing a crime or major sin to go unpunished.
  5. The murder of innocents; aiding a demon or other supernatural agent of evil.

vtmlarp.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages Vampire, revised as The Long Night)
